title: Estabilis upstart.yaml v3
description: Declarative bootstrap specification for the Estabilis Platform. Consumed by N renderers (Python in-process, Argo Workflows, documentation generator). See ADR 0036 (estabilis-platform-tools/docs/adr/0036-upstart-yaml-v3-declarative-bootstrap.md) for design rationale.
$comment: Top-level required list intentionally narrow: only `version` is mandatory in every file. Overlays (upstart.{aws,azure}.yaml) are partial deltas that contribute fields the base supplies elsewhere. The renderer applies post-merge validation: after deep-merge of base + overlay + local, the resulting spec MUST include `bootstrap`, `bootstrap.argocd`, `bootstrap.init`, `bootstrap.wait`, and `waves`. Schema-level checks here cover structural correctness of fields-as-present.

version.description: Schema version. Engine rejects '1' and '2' with instruction to run `estabilis migrate upstart`. Future bumps (3.1, 3.2) follow semver-minor for additive fields and require explicit migration on majors.

bootstrap.$comment: Sub-blocks (argocd, init, wait) are required post-merge but NOT in each individual file (overlays may omit). The renderer enforces post-merge required-set.

pre.description: Steps executed BEFORE ArgoCD is installed. Empty in base (provider-agnostic). AWS overlay carries Karpenter CRDs + controller + resources. Azure overlay empty (AKS managed node pools).

repos.description: Repository credentials registered as ArgoCD Secrets. Entries with empty url or token are silently skipped (matches kubernetes.py:_create_repo_credentials).

defaults.description: Defaults inherited by waves and apps unless overridden. Universal `ServerSideApply=true` resolves cortex prd 2026-04-29 CSA-vs-SSA toggle bug (proposal 0002 §1.1 issues #3 and #4).

waves.description: Sequential ArgoCD Application sync stages. Each wave executes 6 phases (apply-CRDs → trigger-sync → force-reconcile → wait-healthy → optional hardening-resync → verify-checks). Apps within a wave sync in parallel. Wave-level dependencies are expressed by array order, NOT by depends-on field (removed from schema by design — see ADR 0036 §3.5 decision #5).

post.description: Post-last-wave operations. Per ADR 0029, `prune` is decided per-App in chart/ApplicationSet templates by risk taxonomy — NOT by this block. `enable-auto-sync` is a defensive fallback for Apps arriving without any `automated:` block.

prune.description: Defensive fallback only — chart-emitted prune decisions are respected as-is (ADR 0029).

manual-markers.description: Genuinely post-everything operations. Today: empty in all known specs. Wave-inline markers use waves[].manual-marker-after instead (see §4.8 vault-init).

waitMode.description: healthy: wait Application health=Healthy AND sync=Synced (default for ArgoCD-managed apps). synced: wait sync=Synced only. applied: kubectl apply returned 0 (no readiness check). phase-running: wait pod phase=Running (used for Vault where Sealed pods are not Ready by design — see ADR 0036 §4.8).

name.description: Step identifier for logging and resume state.

preStep.description: Pre-bootstrap step. Exactly one of helm-install / helm-template-apply / kubectl-apply / script must be present (oneOf discriminator).

repo.description: OCI URL (oci://...) or HTTPS Helm classic repo (https://...). Engine selects --repo flag or OCI ref accordingly.

version.description: Helm chart version. Pinned (no floating tags). Variables ${X} supported.

values.description: Helm values dict. Strings may reference variables ${X}. Engine resolves before passing to helm.

values-file.description: Path relative to estabilis-platform repo checkout. NO `..` traversal. NO absolute paths.

repo.description: Git URL of the chart's host repo (e.g. estabilis-platform-gitops).

ref.description: Tag, branch, or commit SHA. Engine performs shallow clone.

path.description: Path within the cloned repo to the chart directory.

set.description: Helm --set parameters injected at template time.

namespace.description: Optional target namespace; engine passes via --namespace to helm template + kubectl apply -n.

helmTemplateApply.description: Render a chart living in another git repo and kubectl apply --server-side --force-conflicts. Engine clones shallow at ref, renders helm template with --set, applies, cleans up temp clone. Inherent idempotency via SSA.

manifest.description: Inline YAML manifest (raw string). Engine pipes to kubectl apply --server-side.

run.description: Shell command. Engine executes via subprocess; non-zero exit fails the step. Escape hatch — prefer typed step (helm-install / kubectl-apply) when possible.

skipWhen.description: Step is skipped silently if condition resolves true. Used for non-idempotent steps that must not re-run (e.g. vault-init).

kubectl.description: Engine runs `kubectl get <kind> <name> -n <namespace>`. Skip when resource exists (and matches jsonpath==equals if provided).

file.description: Engine checks file existence on disk relative to cwd. Skip when file exists.

values-file.description: Path relative to estabilis-platform repo checkout — e.g. 'spec/upstart/values/argocd-seed.yaml'. Engine resolves the absolute path.

pre-create-secrets.description: Secrets created BEFORE helm install argocd. Required for argocd-redis (so the chart's redisSecretInit Job stays disabled, avoiding the finalizer deadlock from earlier ArgoCD versions).

data.description: Map of key → value (raw string). Engine base64-encodes when writing the Secret. Values commonly reference ${_X} private variables.

url.description: Git repository URL. If empty after variable resolution, the engine silently skips this entry (matches kubernetes.py:_create_repo_credentials behavior).

token.description: Personal access token. If empty after variable resolution, the engine silently skips.

label.description: Label applied to the resulting Secret for ArgoCD discovery (e.g. 'config-repo', 'client-gitops').

bootstrapInit.$comment: Sub-fields (namespaces, appproject, platform-root) are required post-merge but NOT in each individual file — AWS overlay declares only namespaces[] to append to the base list.

namespaces.description: Component namespaces pre-created before ArgoCD waves to avoid hook race conditions. Base list (13) lives here; provider overlays append (3 in AWS overlay: aws-load-balancer-controller, metrics-server, vault).

sourceRepos.description: Placeholder AppProject. Chart sync via platform-root immediately overwrites with the full ADR 0028 taxonomy (platform-core / platform-observability / platform-security / client / hub).

targetRevision.description: Per ADR 0020, cluster-own content uses branch tracking (e.g. 'main'); external deps stay pinned (vX.Y.Z). Use ${configRepoRevision:-${configRepoVersion}} for transitional backcompat.

ref.description: Names a source for cross-source references (e.g. ref: values, ref: overrides). Mutually informational with path.

parameters.description: Either the string 'auto' (engine injects all params from resolve_platform_params + provenance) or an explicit array of {name, value, forceString}.

condition.description: Renderer-evaluated gate. Source is rendered only when the expression resolves truthy. Supports POSIX ${VAR:+truthy} idiom for is-set checks. Example: ${configRepoUrl:+true} → render only when configRepoUrl is non-empty.

min-count.description: Minimum child Applications platform-root must materialize before waves begin.

stable-rounds.description: Number of consecutive polls where count is stable AND ≥ min-count before declaring convergence.

timeout.description: Total seconds before the wait gives up and fails the bootstrap.

name.description: Wave identifier. Stable across overlays (used as the binding key for `extends:`).

extends.description: Overlay-only directive. Names a base wave to merge with. Arrays (apps, verify) APPEND; scalars overwrite. Engine validates the base wave exists before merging.

insert-before.description: Overlay-only directive. Insert this wave at the position of the named base wave; the named wave (and all subsequent) shift down.

insert-after.description: Overlay-only directive. Insert this wave AFTER the named base wave.

timeout.description: Wave-level default timeout for apps that don't declare their own.

apply-crds.description: CRD apply phase. Engine pipes `helm template <chart>` through `yq 'select(.kind == "CustomResourceDefinition")'` then `kubectl apply --server-side --force-conflicts`. The yq filter is MANDATORY (cortex prd 2026-04-30 postmortem — `helm template --include-crds` does NOT filter and installs full Helm release in `default` namespace; see ADR 0036 §6.6).

apps.description: Apps synced in parallel within this wave. Order is informational only; engine batches the sync triggers.

verify.description: Checks executed after all apps in the wave are Healthy, before advancing.

verify-and-resync.description: When true, after wait-Healthy converges the engine re-triggers sync explicitly on every app in the wave. Catches the `Synced/Healthy parcial` regression (cortex prd 2026-04-30 — Service/metrics-server permanently OutOfSync forever because Phase 9 had already disabled auto-sync). Canonical use: AWS overlay Wave 0.

manual-marker-after.description: Inline manual marker between this wave and the next. Engine prompts operator; honors skip-when. Wave-inline placement is preferred for non-idempotent operations bound to a specific wave (e.g. vault-init after Vault is Running).

manual-marker-before.description: Inline manual marker BEFORE this wave starts.

name.description: ArgoCD Application name (must match the App emitted by the platform-root chart).

optional.description: When true and the App is absent from ArgoCD (chart conditional gated it off), the engine skips silently. When false (default) and the App is absent, the wave fails.

timeout.description: Per-app wait timeout. Overrides wave timeout, defaults timeout.

wait.description: Override wait mode for this app. Vault uses 'phase-running' (Sealed pods are not Ready by design).

name.description: Identifier for logging and resume state.

message.description: Instructional text shown to the operator.
